kind: A screen at full size, one seed, run only if the test bed's screen proportional_gates_with_data finds a fix for late learning or a constant gain of at least 0.010: the proportional gate under the lifting pool against the plain stack under the lifting pool.
why: proportional_gates_with_data.json sends the proportional gate to full size on a fix or a constant gain, in a record of its own written before that run. This is that record, written before the test bed's runs, so that a pass can start the full-size run the same night: the full size is where the gap to the Transformer is measured, and the gated unit is the largest step v15's walk priced (0.025).
arm: fs-pg6-lift: full.sh stack with --lr 6e-4 --granule-gate 4 --granule-ramp 16 --granule-inner-gate --granule-cells 712 --pool-lifts-ceiling: every cell has a value dendrite and a gate dendrite with synapses of its own, the gate fires 4 steps for every threshold of its charge above the rest, at most 64, k steps let k / 64 of the value's charge into the body, and the steps send no pulse; 712 cells a level, 34,783,136 parameters, as fs-gate6-lift
base: fs-st6-lift of full_size_lifted_ceiling_pilot: the plain stack under the lifting pool, same recipe, rate and seed, 1.31341 on the first 2,000,000 validation bytes as streams. Reported beside: fs-st6 (plain, unlifted, 1.31985), fs-gate6 (shunting gate, unlifted, 1.43806) and fs-gate6-lift (shunting gate, lifted, full_size_lifted_gate.json) once scored.
training: full.sh KIND stack (v16's stack with forgetting slopes, 11 levels of 512 channels, windows of 512 bytes, batch 8, 24,000 updates, warmup 1,000, cosine over the run, seed 20001) at peak rate 6e-4; code v17o (26198b3), which computes the base's populations as v17n does
launch: queued held as fs-pg6-lift (priority 5, GPU_MEM 50, either GPU). sched/bin/pg-decide.sh, a CPU job that starts after the test bed's last run, applies proportional_gates_with_data's reading to its eight scores with experiments/read_lead_study.py, writes sched/scores/pg-decision.json and removes the hold only on a fix for late learning or a constant gain; otherwise the job stays held and is retired.
measure: as full_size_lifted_gate: the first 2,000,000 validation bytes as 16 unbroken streams after 8,192 unscored lead bytes, averaged weights, bits kept; paired with fs-st6-lift by experiments/gap_by_piece.py (near 496, far 8,192); the pulses a byte, and the share of gate and cell entries at their caps (experiments/membrane_saturation.py)
reading: The proportional gate earns a place in the next full-size design if fs-pg6-lift scores at least 0.010 below fs-st6-lift and its gain on new contexts has an interval above zero; between 0.005 and 0.010 below, a second seed. Otherwise it is reported only. Recorded either way: the score, the gains by context, the pulses a byte and the gates at their caps.
seen_before_recording: fs-st6 1.31985, fs-st6-lift 1.31341, fs-gate6 1.43806 with 21% of its gate entries at the bound, fs-noise6 1.31571; everything of proportional_gate_check.json; a 2-update CPU check of this arm at full size (finite, 34,783,136 parameters). No run of proportional_gates_with_data has trained, and no full-size run with a proportional gate.
